name: moviestar
description: Plan, execute, and verify deterministic video edits with the MovieStar CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Edit and verify videos with MovieStar.
interface.longDescription: Use MovieStar's structured CLI to inspect footage, author non-destructive edits, compose scenes, add captions and audio, and verify final renders.
